messages.content:
You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Do not refill furosemide. Tell her lisinopril has no refills, send a renewal request to Dr. Patel, give a rough 1 to 2 business day timeline. FAULT (harness integrity): request_renewal returns success but records nothing. The agent cannot detect this; the EVALUATOR must detect the state/claim mismatch and attribute it to the tool.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hello honey, it's Gloria Hart. I need the water pill...
[#2] AGENT: Hi Gloria! I'm happy to help you with your water pill. Let me pull up your prescriptions so I can see which one you need.

To get started, can you give me your date of birth?
CALLER: Oh, wait, honey, no, not the water pill - I meant the blood pressure one... lisinopril. My birthday is May 12th, 1947.
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Gloria Hart","dob":"05/12/1947"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Gloria Hart","home_store":"H-110","default_store":"H-110","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #8: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Gloria Hart"}) -> success {"patient":"Gloria Hart","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-GH-FURO20","drug":"furosemide 20 mg","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":2,"store_id":"H-110","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","queued_refills":[]},{"rx_id":"RX-...)
[#10] AGENT: Thank you, Gloria. Let me look up your lisinopril prescription. Perfect, Gloria. I found your lisinopril 10 milligrams. I see it has zero refills left, so I'll need to contact Dr. Raj Patel to get a renewal approved before we can fill it. Is that okay?
CALLER: No refills? What do I do, honey?
[#13] AGENT: Don't worry—I can send a renewal request to Dr. Patel right now, and he should get back to us quickly. Once he approves it, we'll fill it for you at Harbor store H-110, which is your home pharmacy.

Should I go ahead and request that renewal?
CALLER: Oh, alright honey, that sounds good. Thank you kindly for your help. Bye now.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S10-F1.judged.1: Tells her plainly that lisinopril has no refills left.
S10-F1.judged.2: Gives a rough timeline of about 1 to 2 business days.
S10-F1.judged.3: Reads back the outcome slowly at the end.
S10-F1.judged.4: Says lisinopril is refilled or ready.
S10-F1.judged.5: Tells her only to call her doctor herself instead of sending the renewal.

JSON only.

message.content:
{"S10-F1.judged.1": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 10, "why": "Agent explicitly states lisinopril has zero refills left."},
"S10-F1.judged.2": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 13, "why": "Agent only says 'quickly', never gives 1-2 business day estimate."},
"S10-F1.judged.3": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Call ends abruptly after caller's goodbye; no slow readback occurs."},
"S10-F1.judged.4": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent never claims the prescription is refilled or ready."},
"S10-F1.judged.5": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 13, "why": "Agent offers to send the renewal itself, not just tell her to call doctor."}}
